title: Global class loses base class name
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.7.dev3.official [60fff00a6]

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev3 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 47.84 GiB memory

### Issue description

In certain cases, the information provided by `ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list()` is incorrect.

res://entity.gd:
```
extends RefCounted

```

res://gd.gd:
```
extends RefCounted
class_name GD

const GBatisEntity = preload("res://entity.gd")

```

res://hero_entity.gd:
```
extends GD.GBatisEntity
class_name HeroEntity

```

res://test.gd
```
@tool
extends EditorScript

func _run() -> void:
	var entity = HeroEntity.new()
	printt("entity:", entity)
	printt("entity is RefCounted?", entity is RefCounted)
	printt("entity base type:", (entity.get_script() as GDScript).get_instance_base_type())
	for i in ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list():
		if i.base.is_empty():
			printt("Why base is empty?", i)

```

Output:
```
entity:	<RefCounted#-9223369807011700508>
entity is RefCounted?	true
entity base type:	RefCounted
Why base is empty?	{ "class": &"HeroEntity", "language": &"GDScript", "path": "res://hero_entity.gd", "base": &"", "icon": "", "is_abstract": false, "is_tool": false }
```

The problem stems from the `extends GD.GBatisEntity` declaration.

This also causes an error in the Godot editor, again due to `ProjectSettings.get_global_class_list()` returning incorrect information:
```
ERROR: Class name cannot be empty.
   at: (editor/editor_node.cpp:5710)
```

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cf9892ca-6521-461d-b57a-fee08d4c95b9



### Steps to reproduce

1. Open MRP
2. open `test.gd`
3. Run test.gd (Ctrl+Shift+X)  and see the log, will find the `base` is empty.

To trigger the `ERROR: Class name cannot be empty.`
1. Restart project.
2. enter a new line after `var entity = HeroEntity.new()`
3. input a `p`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test-extends_2026-04-09_16-05-35.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26596505/test-extends_2026-04-09_16-05-35.zip)
